title.en: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor

current_state.zh: OpenAI 已在 2026 开发者日发布 Dots，一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动、可全天候运行、连接 4000 多个应用并跨设备延续上下文的自主智能体；目前已向 ChatGPT Pro 和 Business Premium 用户开放，支持授权限制与自动安全审查，并计划未来支持多个智能体。
current_state.en: OpenAI has launched Dots at its 2026 Developer Day, an always-on autonomous agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, connecting to 4,000+ apps and carrying context across devices; currently available to ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium users, with authorization limits and automated safety review, and future plans for multiple agents.

updates.title_en: OpenAI launches Dots, its Muse competitor
updates.what_changed_zh: 在DevDay主题演讲中，OpenAI发布了Dots，这是一款始终在线的代理式AI助手，可在后台跨连接的应用程序工作，由新的GPT-6 Astra模型驱动，直指Meta的Muse。
updates.what_changed_en: At its DevDay keynote, OpenAI announced Dots, an always-on agentic AI assistant that works across connected apps in the background and is powered by the new GPT-6 Astra model, taking aim at Meta's Muse.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI推出全天候自主智能体Dots，挑战Meta Muse
updates.title_en: OpenAI推出全天候自主智能体Dots，挑战Meta Muse
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：Dots 运行在独立云端环境，可连接超过 4000 个应用（含 Teams、Slack），跨设备延续上下文；支持用户设置授权限制与自动安全审查；目前已向 ChatGPT Pro 和 Business Premium 用户开放，并测试企业用户创建专用“专家型”Dots；未来计划支持多个 Dots。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds: Dots runs in an isolated cloud environment, connects to 4,000+ apps including Teams and Slack, carries context across devices; supports user-set authorization limits and automated safety review; currently available to ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium users, with enterprise 'expert' Dots being tested; future plans include multiple Dots.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 已在 2026 开发者日发布 Dots，一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动、可全天候运行、连接 4000 多个应用并跨设备延续上下文的自主智能体；目前已向 ChatGPT Pro 和 Business Premium 用户开放，支持授权限制与自动安全审查，并计划未来支持多个智能体。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI has launched Dots at its 2026 Developer Day, an always-on autonomous agent powered by GPT-6 Astra, connecting to 4,000+ apps and carrying context across devices; currently available to ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium users, with authorization limits and automated safety review, and future plans for multiple agents.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: At its 2026 Developer Day keynote, OpenAI launched Dots, an always-on autonomous AI agent powered by the GPT-6 Astra model that runs in an isolated cloud environment, connects to 4,000+ apps including Teams and Slack, carries context across devices, and supports user-set authorization limits and automated safety review — positioned as a direct answer to Meta's Muse assistant.
